message: Lord of Wei, Qin’s possession of Luoyang threatens both Zheng and Yewang directly. I propose we seal a non-aggression pact and coordinate our defenses to stop Qin’s eastern advance. By securing our mutual border, we can focus our remaining forces on expanding into weaker territories later.
reasoning: Wei shares a direct border with my capital Zheng at Yewang and faces the same existential threat from Qin. An alliance here stabilizes my eastern flank and leverages Wei’s greater strength to deter Qin without committing to offensive action yet.
